objects.label: Stainless side-by-side refrigerator
objects.identity_description: Physical stainless two-door refrigerator with a black dispenser on its left door, recessed below white cabinets immediately to the left of the dark blue door. Includes the appliance front and handles; excludes the white cabinet surround. Selected from direct view in anchor frame 5.

objects.label: Stainless chimney range hood
objects.identity_description: Physical stainless extractor hood above the cooking range, comprising the sloped broad canopy and visible rectangular chimney, between white glass-front cabinets below the high windows. Excludes the range, wall and reflections in adjacent cabinet glass. Selected from direct view in anchor frame 5.
